purpose: TASK-052: prove findSkuRefsInTransaction reads only this Supplier's rows on the caller's transaction. The PO Line foreign key has one column, so the database cannot catch a wrong Supplier's ref, and a fake cannot prove the SQL. Checker wiring: prove through the real routes that a Supplier referenced by a PO cannot change its Code and that an open PO blocks archive, and that lock conflicts answer 409 CONCURRENT_OPERATION with nothing written. S0: verify the historical Supplier lookup on the caller's connection, including an archived Supplier, missing ID, and a non-bank projection without row locks. Supplier S1: prove AP protects Supplier Code and permanent deletion, and that confirmed unpaid invoices name an archive blocker while paid invoices do not block archive. The existing shared factory case also checks AP wiring.
data: No-DB case: fake rows only. MySQL case: 3 items, 3 SKUs, 2 Suppliers, 3 committed relations, 1 relation inserted inside the transaction. Inputs include duplicates, an empty list, 100 IDs and 101 IDs on the fake. Checker wiring: unit cases use fakes; the 3 route-level cases use 1 Supplier and 1 directly inserted purchase_orders row each, deleted in the case. S0: one mocked supplier row, then an empty mocked result. No database workload. Supplier S1: one Supplier and one synthetic AP invoice in the first scenario, then mark it paid; one Supplier and one synthetic historical AP payment in the second. Existing Supplier harness and cleanup.
concurrency: 1 connection and 1 transaction in the MySQL case's own reads and write; serial within the existing shard. No two-connection trial. Checker wiring: serial; no two-connection case.
thresholds: Exact equality on the returned Map; TypeError on invalid input; no locking clause in the SQL. No performance threshold. Checker wiring: exact status codes and error codes; no performance threshold. S0: exact projection and null, no locking SQL, and no new transaction. Supplier S1: exact domain conflict and blocker names, unchanged version and state on a rejected archive, and archive allowed after payment.
trigger: Routine functional server tests through existing discovery. One natural CI run on one push. No new job, schedule, dispatch or retry. No capacity: audit-17 and audit-18 are only statically related and are not selected on a PR. Checker wiring: routine functional server tests through existing discovery; one PR CI.
cost: Estimated under 1 second for the no-DB case and a few seconds for the MySQL case; not measured. No new job; effect on the CI critical path expected to be negligible, not measured. Checker wiring: 12 cases; unit cases run in milliseconds; the 3 route cases took about 0.4 s in total locally. Not a measured CI cost. S0: one additional unit case, observed under one millisecond of test body time; no new runner or job. Supplier S1: two functional HTTP cases; browser evidence is local only. No additional job or dispatch.
